title: lorastats v1
$comment: CANONICAL DIALECT: bare field names, integer values. Re-derived from the 29 Aug 2026 production sample, in which lorastats arrived in THREE mutually incompatible dialects in three consecutive records - bare/integer, bare/string ('176'), and lora_-prefixed/integer (lora_rx_nr_pkts) - all three carrying version:1, so nothing on the record discriminates them. Per ADR-007 §4 this schema encodes ONE dialect and the other two are DEAD-LETTERED rather than absorbed by a permissive union, so the disagreement is visible in the DLQ instead of being silently normalised away. Bare/integer was chosen because it matches omsstats, which shares the same converter family. THIS IS AN ASSUMPTION, NOT AN ANSWER: it rejects an estimated two thirds of lorastats traffic and is the single most urgent question for ZC (ADR-007 §6). rx_short_pkt, fsk_received and rx_type_arol are observed in production, are OPTIONAL because no record carries all three, and are typed so a dialect that sends them as strings still dead-letters. timespan is optional: the bare/string record omits it entirely.
